Class SecurityDividendsChart

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.reportviews.securitydividends.SecurityDividendsChart
public class SecurityDividendsChart extends Object
Income and cost figures of the dividends report, aggregated for its charts. The values are built from the same transactions and with the same exchange rates as SecurityDividendsGrandTotal, so the yearly totals of the charts reconcile with the dividends table. Individual securities are deliberately not broken down; the finest grouping is the asset class.
